description.value: Vina Taste is a Vietnamese restaurant specializing in pho and noodle soups, located inside Westshore Town Centre mall in Langford on the western side of Greater Victoria. The restaurant occupies unit 105 within the large regional shopping centre, giving touring cyclists access to a hot, filling bowl of broth and noodles alongside the mall's broader range of services.
